find_params_by_condition: find a single experiment run matching specific hyperparameter conditions from a list of data dicts
find_all_params_by_condition: find all experiment runs matching specific hyperparameter conditions from a list of data dicts
load_stats_from_folder: load stats and config from a single experiment folder returning args, stats, and path
load_data_from_root: load stats from all unique experiment folders under a root directory deduplicating by prefix
convert_stats_to_summary: convert full stats in a folder to a summary file keeping only first and last entries
